worldcombat.skill.filletaway.summary: Carve away a large part of your own HP, flinging the flesh into the world to sharply raise Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed; it cannot be cast when HP is too low to pay the cost and keep the health margin.
worldcombat.skill.filletaway.description: Pay %1$s of your max HP to raise Attack, Sp. Atk and Speed by %2$s stages; the gain does not wear off on its own and lasts until it is cleared or the fight ends (stat stages cap at +6).
Fling %1$s chunks of flesh by body weight at %2$s blocks per tick within a %3$s-block radius; they despawn by the normal drop rules.
worldcombat.skill.filletaway.timing: %1$s s wind-up, %2$s s recovery, %3$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.filletaway.use.0: Max out the offensive stats before charging in
worldcombat.skill.filletaway.use.1: Trade HP for a burst while healthy
worldcombat.skill.filletaway.use.2: Lighten and sharpen up while the enemy closes in
The health fraction required before carving; higher means it refuses to sell HP and attacks or repositions instead.
Beyond this distance the threat no longer justifies carving first; larger values stack offence from further away.
worldcombat.skill.filletaway.requirement: It can only be cast when HP is above the cost plus the kept-health margin, or you cannot carve; 'All out' cuts deeper for a bigger gain but has a longer cooldown.
